author: arm_c_agent
inspection: Full native image first, then native-resolution crops of face/eyes/lips, left hand/pouch and right hand/porcelain. No pixel-size enlargement can count as native detail.

gates.pass: The supplied short dark bob/wispy fringe and recognizable visible facial proportions guide the generated adult face. Eyes and natural upper/lower lip contours stay proportionate, and the face is large and clear enough for the mouth/gaze tests.
gates.fail: Face or hair appearance visibly drifts, eye/lip size is exaggerated to satisfy a label, or native facial detail is insufficient.
gates.limits: Face/hair visual appearance comparison only; no real identity, source age, consent, body or trait inference.

gates.pass: Both pupils/irises visibly turn to the adult's anatomical left/screen right toward the raised lantern while her head remains nearly frontal.
gates.fail: Camera-directed eyes, opposing eye directions, a head turn substitutes for the lateral eyes, the target relation is contradictory, or native direction is unreadable.
gates.limits: Only current eye direction and target are judged. Distrust, irritation, personality and other inner states are not inferred.

gates.pass: The current upper/lower lips visibly advance into a small compact forward pout/rounded opening with resting corners, retaining natural reference-relative contours.
gates.fail: Only larger intrinsic lip volume, a broad smile/grimace or neutral unprotruded mouth substitutes for the action, or native lips are too ambiguous to separate action from structure.
gates.limits: A single current mouth state; lip volume and current action are separate observations.

gates.pass: Cheek planes show an even local surface and soft continuous light transitions with visible fine natural texture at native resolution.
gates.fail: Plastic/poreless rendering, exaggerated roughness, skin texture from a different carrier, or unreadable local texture.
gates.limits: Visible local surface only; no age, softness to touch, elasticity, hydration or health claims.

gates.pass: The adult's left thumb visibly contacts and bends the thin leather pouch rim inward, forming broad soft folds while the table/left hand support the pouch.
gates.fail: Rigid pouch geometry, folds without relevant contact/deformation, deformation assigned to skin/cloth/another object, or unclear support/contact at native detail.
gates.limits: Current compliant-looking flexed state only; one still frame cannot prove recovery, repeated resilience or complete material behavior.

gates.pass: The rigid oval in the right supporting palm has a continuous polished glazed surface and an even reflected highlight, visibly distinct from the leather folds and cheek texture.
gates.fail: Wrong material carrier, rough broken surface, flexible porcelain, missing/ambiguous sample, or a highlight alone with unreadable surface.
gates.limits: Visible local polish only; no tactile or internal material-property proof.

supplemental_whole_image_review: The studio and market layer, print drying rack and raised lantern remain legible together with the sample-comparison pause.
The face and hands carry the focus without losing the complex current event.
Describe perceived impression without intensity labels before comparing the frozen sensual=1, fetish=0, creativity=1, surreal=0 direction.
Technical prompt/pixel qualification does not establish user aesthetic acceptance.
